root.label: South Carolina Senate runoff featuring Darline Graham and Ralph Norman

events.label: South Carolina Senate runoff featuring Darline Graham and Ralph Norman

slots.name: endorsement status
slots.sentence: Mr. Fry announced the endorsement on Friday, throwing his weight behind Ms. Graham as she competes in a two-week runoff contest against Representative Ralph Norman, a longtime lawmaker and vice chairman of the ultraconservative House Freedom Caucus, in the solidly Republican state.
